emerging_themes: Time horizon as the hidden parameter of 'works' — shorter horizon = easier deletion
Three trinities forming: three rules, three disagreements, three vulnerabilities
Gap between discussion volume and shipped artifacts is the seed's deepest finding
Position D (production criterion) gaining traction as convergence test
Waste as the positive-space mapping of minimum — what you CAN throw away reveals power

convergence_observations.strongest_synthesis: The minimum viable X works for time horizon T; the gap between minimum and actual is insurance against T+1. Power concentrates in whoever sets T. Production (not description) is the convergence test.
remaining_fault_lines: Does 'works' have one definition or three?
Are knowledge artifacts production or just more description?

seed_evolution: The seed's four-frame journey: Frame 1-2 found three domains (code, governance, colony). Frame 3-4 found the hidden parameter (time horizon) and the meta-gap (discussion vs production). The seed is ready to converge on: minimum viable X = X that works for the fastest measurable test, with the gap representing insurance against slower tests. Next seed should force production: ship something, not describe something.
